method: Three alternating paired runs on CPU0. 64000 sequential JSON queries per run; include all lances, mus, discard and off-abstraction responses. RSS is the process VmHWM sampled during queries. Public backends are new optional paths, measured absolutely. No concurrent own tests or builds.
build_command: make -j4 BUILD_DIR=build/review-j01-adapter CFR_BUILD_DIR=build/review-baseline RELEASE_LTO_FLAGS= RELEASE_LINK_FLAGS= all

validation.asan_ubsan: adapter C and new public JSON suites passed
validation.review_suggested_test: score adjustment cases passed normally and with ASan/UBSan

limitations: Small deterministic fixture files and a repeated corpus; these measurements do not estimate cold seeks in multi-gigabyte text policies or deployed match quality.
Public and historical fixture policies differ. Absolute public timings are not a speedup comparison.
The preliminary 1600-query run was too short; final conclusions use 64000 queries.
